verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships a built-in scheduler ('Automations') that persists jobs, wakes the agent autonomously, and delivers output to channels/webhooks, plus webhooks and standing orders granting agents permanent autonomous operating authority — directly matching background autonomous automation. Community evidence corroborates real-world autonomous use (e.g. running multiple scheduled agents doing home-IT chores). missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of scheduler reliability at scale, and clearer documentation of failure/retry semantics for missed wake-ups.
